name: Copper/Gold Ratio & S&P 500 Forward Returns
description: Analyzes the copper/gold ratio as a leading indicator for S&P 500 (SPY) 3-month forward returns. Regime defined by ratio vs its 63-day SMA: rising = ratio above SMA, falling = ratio below SMA. Shows ratio context with regime coloring, regime flip event markers, median forward returns by regime, return distribution comparison (boxplot), and a stats reference table (N, median, hit rate, best, worst).
source:
# =============================================================================
# COPPER/GOLD RATIO & S&P 500 FORWARD RETURNS
# =============================================================================
# Question: Does a rising copper/gold ratio predict better SPY returns?
#
# Regime: ratio above vs below its 63-day SMA
# Chart 1: Copper/gold ratio colored by regime (context)
# Event markers: each regime flip (rising ↔ falling)
# Chart 2: Median 63d SPY forward return by regime (punchline)
# Chart 3: Boxplot of 63d SPY forward returns by regime (distribution)
# Table:   N, median, hit rate, best, worst per regime (reference)
#
# Data:
#   - SPY (primary asset, market_data_source)
#   - HG (COMEX copper, reference_futures + continuation, NoAdjustment)
#   - GC (COMEX gold, reference_futures + continuation, NoAdjustment)
#   NoAdjustment for both metals — ratio analysis requires unadjusted prices (D16)
# =============================================================================

# --- Primary Asset: SPY ---
spy_src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
spy_close = spy_src.c

# --- Copper Futures Continuation (NoAdjustment for ratio) ---
hg_raw = reference_futures(ticker='HG')()
hg = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(hg_raw.o, hg_raw.h, hg_raw.l, hg_raw.c, hg_raw.v, hg_raw.oi, hg_raw.s)

# --- Gold Futures Continuation (NoAdjustment for ratio) ---
gc_raw = reference_futures(ticker='GC')()
gc = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(gc_raw.o, gc_raw.h, gc_raw.l, gc_raw.c, gc_raw.v, gc_raw.oi, gc_raw.s)

# --- Copper/Gold Ratio ---
# Forward-fill both to handle any calendar misalignment between metals and SPY
hg_close = ffill(hg.c)
gc_close = ffill(gc.c)
cg_ratio = hg_close / gc_close

# --- Regime: 63-day SMA crossover ---
ratio_sma63 = ma(period=63, type=MAType.sma)(cg_ratio)
is_rising = is_valid(ratio_sma63) and cg_ratio > ratio_sma63
is_falling = is_valid(ratio_sma63) and cg_ratio <= ratio_sma63

# Regime label for boxplot grouped mode
regime_label = 'Rising' if is_rising else ('Falling' if is_falling else 'Unknown')

# --- Regime flip detection for event markers ---
# crossover/crossunder on the ratio vs its SMA
flip_to_rising = crossover(cg_ratio, ratio_sma63)
flip_to_falling = crossunder(cg_ratio, ratio_sma63)
any_flip = flip_to_rising or flip_to_falling
flip_direction = 'Rising' if flip_to_rising else 'Falling'

# --- SPY 63-day forward return (3 months ahead) ---
# forward_returns on price series is safe (S46)
spy_fwd_63d = forward_returns(period=63)(spy_close)

# --- Forward returns by regime (for bar chart aggregation) ---
# Use ternary (not where) so NaN regime days contribute 0 to hit rate calc
fwd_rising = where(is_rising, spy_fwd_63d)
fwd_falling = where(is_falling, spy_fwd_63d)

# Hit rate: 1.0 if positive return, 0.0 if negative (NaN-guarded)
hit_rising = 1.0 if (is_valid(spy_fwd_63d) and is_rising and spy_fwd_63d > 0) else 0.0
hit_falling = 1.0 if (is_valid(spy_fwd_63d) and is_falling and spy_fwd_63d > 0) else 0.0

# --- Ratio colored by regime (for context chart) ---
ratio_when_rising = where(is_rising, cg_ratio)
ratio_when_falling = where(is_falling, cg_ratio)

bar_ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# Chart 1 (CONTEXT): Copper/gold ratio colored by regime
# Rising = Blue (bullish signal), Falling = Gray
xy_lines(
    title='Copper/Gold Ratio: Rising vs Falling Regime (63d SMA)',
    category='Copper/Gold Ratio & SPY Returns',
    order=1,
    y_axis_label='Copper/Gold Ratio',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Rising (Bullish)', color=Color.Blue, area=True),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Falling (Bearish)', color=Color.Gray, area=True)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ])
)(x_values=bar_ts, y_values=(ratio_when_rising, ratio_when_falling))

# Event Markers: Regime flips (rising ↔ falling)
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Regime Flip',
        icon=Icon.ArrowUpDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='New Regime', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge,
                       card_color_map={"Success": ["Rising"], "Error": ["Falling"]}),
            ColumnSpec(title='Cu/Au Ratio', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='SPY Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(flip_direction, cg_ratio, spy_close, any_flip)

# Chart 2 (PUNCHLINE): Median 63d SPY forward return by regime
# Grouped bar: Rising vs Falling, side by side
xy_bars(
    title='Does a Rising Cu/Au Ratio Predict Better SPY Returns?',
    category='Copper/Gold Ratio & SPY Returns',
    order=2,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_label='Median 63d Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Median 63d Return', color=Color.Blue, stack='Rising'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Median 63d Return', color=Color.Gray, stack='Falling')
    ])
)(values=(fwd_rising, fwd_falling))

# Chart 3 (DISTRIBUTION): Boxplot of 63d SPY forward returns by regime
# Grouped mode: label = regime_label, values = spy_fwd_63d
boxplot(
    title='SPY 63d Return Distribution by Cu/Au Regime',
    category='Copper/Gold Ratio & SPY Returns',
    order=3,
    y_axis_label='63d Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Gray],
    show_outliers=True,
    show_data_labels=True
)(label=regime_label, values=spy_fwd_63d)

# Table (REFERENCE): N, median, hit rate, best, worst per regime
# Standard mode: 2 columns (Rising, Falling) × 5 rows (N, Median, Hit Rate, Best, Worst)
summary_table(
    category='Copper/Gold Ratio & SPY Returns',
    order=0,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='SPY 63d Forward Return Stats by Cu/Au Regime',
        row_size=5,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['N (Observations)', 'Median Return', 'Hit Rate (% Positive)', 'Best Return', 'Worst Return'],
        col_headers=['Rising Regime', 'Falling Regime'],
        cells=[
            # Row 0: N
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,
                       type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,
                       type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0),
            # Row 1: Median return
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1,
                       grid_color_map={"Success": ["POSITIVE"], "Error": ["NEGATIVE"]}),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1,
                       grid_color_map={"Success": ["POSITIVE"], "Error": ["NEGATIVE"]}),
            # Row 2: Hit rate
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            # Row 3: Best
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            # Row 4: Worst
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    )
)(fwd_rising, fwd_falling, hit_rising, hit_falling, fwd_rising, fwd_falling, fwd_rising, fwd_falling, fwd_rising, fwd_falling)
